metadata.title: SSPP Template - Entra ID Single Sign-On (SSO)
metadata.remarks: Normative SSPP template defining institutional identity, authentication, authorization, and conditional access expectations using Microsoft Entra ID. This SSPP establishes trust boundaries and governance expectations for all SSO-integrated services.

import-profile.remarks: Imports institutional baseline security, identity, and access governance requirements.

system-characteristics.system-description: Central identity provider and single sign-on service for institutional users, applications, and platforms, providing authentication, authorization, and conditional access enforcement.

props.name: institutional-owner
props.remarks: Owns institutional identity lifecycle, authentication standards, and access governance.

props.name: technical-owner
props.remarks: Defines and enforces security controls, conditional access, and identity risk management.

props.name: identity-provider
props.remarks: Microsoft Entra ID is the authoritative identity provider for institutional authentication.

props.name: governance-model
props.remarks: Identity, authentication, and conditional access controls are centrally governed. Delegation is limited and controlled.

props.name: authentication-model
props.remarks: SSO is provided to applications using federation or modern authentication protocols.

props.name: multi-factor-authentication
props.remarks: Multi-factor authentication is required for interactive user authentication in accordance with institutional policy.

props.name: conditional-access
props.remarks: Risk-based conditional access controls are enforced for users, devices, locations, and applications.

props.name: coarse-grained-authorization
props.remarks: Access to the service MUST be restricted at the Entra ID level using enterprise application assignment or equivalent controls.

props.name: fine-grained-authorization
props.remarks: Fine-grained authorization SHOULD be enforced using Entra ID groups where feasible. Service-internal role models are permitted but introduce governance and attestation risk.

props.name: privileged-access
props.remarks: Privileged roles are subject to additional controls, including just-in-time access and heightened monitoring.

props.name: logging-and-audit
props.remarks: Authentication, authorization, and conditional access events are logged centrally and integrated with institutional SIEM.

system-implementation.remarks: This SSPP template defines identity governance and security expectations. Application-specific integrations and role mappings are documented in SSPP instances.

components.title: Microsoft Entra ID Core Services
components.description: Provides authentication, federation, conditional access, and identity governance for institutional users and applications.

components.title: Conditional Access Enforcement
components.description: Risk-based access control enforcing MFA, device trust, location restrictions, and session controls.

components.title: Identity Logging and Monitoring
components.description: Centralized logging of identity events for audit, investigation, and correlation.

links.text: Identity events are forwarded to the institutional SIEM.

roles.title: Identity Policy Authority
roles.remarks: Aligned to NIST NICE SP-PLN-001 (Cybersecurity Policy and Strategy Planner). Defines authentication, MFA, and conditional access posture.

roles.title: Identity Architect
roles.remarks: Aligned to NIST NICE SP-ARC-001 (Enterprise Architect). Designs identity integration patterns and trust boundaries.

roles.title: Identity Operations
roles.remarks: Aligned to NIST NICE OM-ADM-001 and PR-CY-001. Operates identity services and enforces access controls.

roles.title: Identity Monitoring and Assessment
roles.remarks: Aligned to NIST NICE PR-CDA-001 and SP-RSK-001. Monitors authentication events and supports assessments and SARs.

control-implementation.remarks: Control satisfaction is demonstrated through enforced MFA, conditional access policies, group-based authorization, and centrally logged identity events.
